title: Renewal Cushion Rule — Residential Natural Gas Supply In-Term Renewals
content:
For a Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement renewed within its term, the renewal cushion acts on the reduced renewal rate, according to the agreement's pricing structure. The reduced renewal rate is the renewal rate per therm as it stands before the renewal cushion and before its final rounding.

## Net supply cost per therm

The net supply cost per therm is the total of every bill line amount on the agreement, whatever its kind (energy charges, service fees, rebill credits, sign-up credits, renewal loyalty credits or any other line that carries a billing period), whose billing period starts later than the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date, divided by the therms of the energy lines of those cycles and rounded half up to four decimal places; when no energy line falls in that window, the net supply cost per therm is the contract rate.

## The cushion

When the agreement is on a capped variable plan and the reduced renewal rate is above the net supply cost per therm, the renewal cushion takes away the renewal cushion share of the amount by which the reduced renewal rate exceeds the net supply cost per therm, rounded half up to four decimal places; when the agreement is on a fixed plan and the reduced renewal rate is above the contract rate multiplied by 1.10 and rounded half up to four decimal places, the reduced renewal rate is lowered to that product; in every other case the reduced renewal rate stands.

| Pricing structure | Condition | Result |
|---|---|---|
| capped variable | reduced rate above the net supply cost per therm | reduced rate less the cushion share of the excess, rounded half up to four decimal places |
| capped variable | reduced rate at or below the net supply cost per therm | reduced rate stands |
| fixed | reduced rate above the contract rate multiplied by 1.10 (rounded half up to four decimal places) | lowered to that product |
| fixed | reduced rate at or below that product | reduced rate stands |
| variable (month-to-month) | any | reduced rate stands |

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreements; acceptance date 15 August 2025)

- **Net supply cost.** Lines of cycles starting from 16 August 2024 onward: energy charges 698.40 over 880 therms, service fees 44.55, a rebill credit of minus 7.28 and a sign-up credit of minus 40.00. The total is 695.67; divided by 880 therms it is 0.790534, rounded half up to 0.7905.
- **Capped variable.** Reduced rate 0.8350, net supply cost 0.7900, cushion share 0.50: the excess is 0.0450, half of it is 0.0225, and the rate becomes 0.8125. With a share of 0.25 the amount taken away is 0.01125, giving 0.82375, rounded half up to 0.8238.
- **Fixed.** Contract rate 0.7000: multiplied by 1.10 it is 0.7700. A reduced rate of 0.7900 is lowered to 0.7700; a reduced rate of 0.7650 stands.
